headline.title: [Sample] New chip export rules published; industry sees limited supply-chain impact
headline.summary: In this fictional story, regulators publish a revised export-control framework that adds reporting requirements for some advanced equipment. Several firms say near-term orders are unaffected but compliance paperwork will increase.
headline.why: Rising compliance cost is the long-term variable to watch.
headline.original_title: New chip export rules limited impact

brief: [Sample data] New chip export rules are seen as having limited near-term impact. A workflow tool adds native AI nodes. A new quarter of energy subsidies is announced.

items.title: [Sample] Obsidian Tech launches a voice-agent platform with 300 ms latency
items.summary: The platform claims about 300 ms end-to-end latency and supports mixed-language customer service. Two restaurant chains appear as sample customers.
items.why: Low latency decides whether voice AI feels natural.
items.original_title: Obsidian Tech launches voice agent platform

items.title: [Sample] Open community proposes a new long-document chunking benchmark
items.summary: The benchmark compares chunking and re-ranking strategies on contracts and papers; re-ranking contributes the most.
items.why: A direct guide to tuning for anyone building RAG.
items.original_title: New benchmark for long-document chunking

items.title: [Sample] Pilot schools require students to disclose how they used AI on homework
items.summary: Teachers use process logs instead of detection tools to review AI use in a sample pilot program.
items.why: Verifiable learning records beat detection.
items.original_title: Pilot requires AI-use disclosure on homework

items.title: [Sample] Small team replaces costly labeling outsourcing with a 20-line script
items.summary: The author pre-labels with a model and spot-checks by hand, cutting labeling cost by about 70%.
items.why: A pattern teams on a budget can copy.
items.original_title: A twenty-line script replaces labeling outsourcing

items.title: [Sample] Workflow tool adds native AI nodes with structured output
items.summary: The update adds a node that takes a JSON schema, retries on failure and logs the raw response.
items.why: Directly cuts the maintenance cost of malformed LLM output.
items.original_title: Workflow tool adds native AI nodes

items.title: [Sample] Static sites backed by a folder of JSON become a personal-database trend
items.summary: More people keep data as version-controlled JSON and render it with a static site, skipping database upkeep.
items.why: Traceable and revertible, ideal for personal projects.
items.original_title: Static sites backed by JSON folders

items.title: [Sample] Designing webhook retries: three ways to build idempotency keys
items.summary: The post compares request IDs, content hashes and resource versions as idempotency keys.
items.why: Prevents duplicate commits when you re-run the same day.
items.original_title: Three ways to build webhook idempotency keys

items.title: [Sample] Protein-structure tool update improves membrane-protein accuracy
items.summary: A new version adds dedicated training data for membrane proteins, cutting error by 15% on a sample test set.
items.why: Membrane proteins are targets for many drugs.
items.original_title: Protein structure tool improves membrane predictions

items.title: [Sample] Wearable blood-oxygen patch receives registration approval
items.summary: A patch that monitors blood oxygen continuously is approved, aimed at elderly home care.
items.why: Home monitoring makes chronic-disease care more timely.
items.original_title: Home blood-oxygen patch approved

items.title: [Sample] Gene editing: salt-tolerant rice enters field trials
items.summary: Researchers planted salt-tolerant rice in a coastal test field; early results show smaller yield losses.
items.why: Stress-tolerant crops matter more as the climate shifts.
items.original_title: Salt-tolerant rice enters field trials

items.title: [Sample] New quarter of energy subsidies announced, household tiers adjusted
items.summary: The sample plan adjusts subsidy tiers so households with lower monthly usage receive a larger share of relief.
items.why: Directly affects household electricity bills.
items.original_title: New energy subsidy plan announced

items.title: [Sample] Southern science park opens a shared lab that startups rent by the hour
items.summary: The shared lab offers basic measurement equipment, billed by usage hours.

items.original_title: Shared lab opens in southern science park

items.title: [Sample] High-speed rail and conventional rail trial a joint ticket
items.summary: Travelers can buy cross-system tickets on one platform, with a 10% discount during the trial.
items.why: Easier transfers.

items.title: [Sample] Ministry publishes this year’s independent bookstore grants
